g.text: Cue — Generation Job State Machine (animation_job.status, FR-07, NFR-03)
Every transition is a conditional UPDATE "WHERE status = <expected state>"
started_at, finished_at, video, frames, locked_by = NULL
set atomically by the worker claim
started_at, locked_by, heartbeat_at, model_version_id NOT NULL
finished_at NOT NULL, video, frames = NULL, error_code = NULL
Terminal states are final: no UPDATE can leave them
(all guards test status), so a late worker result is rejected (0 rows) and its media is discarded.
Matches database CHECK constraints animation_job_state_queued / running / done / failed / cancelled
Colours: purple = active (non-terminal), green = successful terminal, grey = failed or cancelled terminal.
Not drawn because not committed: retry, pause, draft.
